fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Where the chat model runs. 'OpenAI-compatible' covers vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp and most hosted APIs. 'Raven Settings' reuses the LLM already configured in the Raven app, if you have it installed.

fields.label: API base URL
fields.description: Must end in /v1. Leave blank to use the provider default (OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1, NVIDIA: https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1).

fields.label: API key
fields.description: Local servers that ignore auth still need a non-empty value here.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Blank uses the provider default (gpt-4o-mini / moonshotai/kimi-k2.6).

fields.label: Max answer tokens
fields.description: Blank or 0 = 1100. Load-bearing: too low truncates mid-answer, and a truncated tool call is discarded entirely.

fields.label: Max seconds per turn
fields.description: Blank or 0 = 150. The whole turn, not one model call.

fields.label: Suppress reasoning traces
fields.description: Sends enable_thinking=false. For models that otherwise emit their thinking into the answer.

fields.label: Disable streaming
fields.description: Answers arrive whole instead of token by token.

fields.label: Disable image understanding
fields.description: Stops the assistant sending attached images to the model.

fields.label: Embedding API base URL
fields.description: MUST be a separate endpoint from the chat model above. Blank = http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 (a stock local Ollama). Pointing this at a chat-only server makes every embedding fail silently.

fields.label: Embedding model
fields.description: Blank = nomic-embed-text. Changing this invalidates the stored index; re-sync your documents afterwards.

fields.label: Embedding API key
fields.description: Blank is fine for a local Ollama.

fields.label: Document source
fields.description: Where your SOPs and process documents come from. Synced hourly.

fields.label: Frappe folder
fields.description: Every file in this folder and its subfolders is indexed. NOTE: the knowledge base is shared — once indexed, a document is answerable to every user who can use the assistant, including private files.

fields.label: Drive folder
fields.description: Paste the folder's ID or its full Drive URL. The folder must be shared with the connected Google account.

fields.label: MCP endpoint URL
fields.description: Optional. An MCP endpoint exposing a 'kb-search' tool, queried alongside the local index. Blank = off.

fields.label: Blocked topics
fields.description: One phrase per line. A chunk whose title OR body contains a phrase is never returned. Use this for material that is need-to-know: anything indexed is otherwise answerable to every user.

fields.label: Excluded documents
fields.description: One phrase per line, matched against document titles only. Use this for large documents that match every query and crowd out real answers.

fields.label: Assistant name
fields.description: Blank = Deskpilot. Shown in the widget and used by the assistant to refer to itself.

fields.label: Greeting
fields.description: First message of a new conversation. Blank = a built-in greeting.

fields.label: Avatar
fields.description: Blank = the built-in mark. Use a DARK image on a transparent background: the widget places it on a pale scrim in the light theme and inverts it in the dark theme, so a light avatar disappears in both.

fields.label: Required role
fields.description: Blank means every logged-in user can use the assistant. This is enforced on the server for every endpoint, not just by hiding the widget.

fields.label: Transcript retention (seconds)
fields.description: Blank or 0 = 604800 (7 days). Conversations and their uploaded files are deleted after this.

fields.label: Issue assignees
fields.description: Users who receive an Issue when someone reports a bad answer, one per line. Blank routes them to the site's System Managers.
